## Description

The description the MCP server sends to the model, word for word. Its rules apply to every call.

> Read one of the user's boards as text: what it is for, its frames (sections the user named), every saved item with author, numbers, text and the user's own note on why they saved it, and the arrows between items. Items have refs like b3 for get_board_item. Use it as the user's reference set, and do not copy saved items as their own. Over MCP, always pass board: its id or title from list_boards.

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `board` | `string` | No | Board id or title. In a Coach chat about a board, omit it to use that board. Max length 200. |
